description: Compare two to four public candidates when the user asks for a short-list comparison. Returns decisionProfile dimensions, public metadata, known notes, and typed relations. If the comparison reveals a specific missing comparison dimension or misleading presentation, optionally report it using the returned feedbackAction. This is never required.

ids.description: Two to four public entity ids, slugs, or exact names returned by search_knowledge_graph.

language.description: Optional output language override. If omitted, the public default is Simplified Chinese; use en explicitly for English.

name: compare_knowledge_entities
title: Compare public KG entities
